Already the leading platform of adventure creators and brands, Popfly is a place where collaboration replaces chaos, and authentic partnerships replace transactional campaigns. Brands like GoPro, Smith Optics, and Backcountry use Popfly to discover vetted creators, collaborate through the entire creative process, and track performance that actually drives revenue. Creators use us to connect with brands they actually care about, manage their workflow, and get paid.
 



  





 We’re a fast\-scaling startup that’s proven product\-market fit and is now racing from thousands to millions of users. Our small and nimble engineering team has built a sophisticated platform that handles everything from creator\-brand matching to real\-time collaboration tools, payment processing, affiliate tracking, and analytics \- all purpose\-built for the adventure space. We believe perfect is the enemy of shipped, and pragmatic excellence beats over\-engineered solutions every time. We’re not building one\-off campaigns; we’re building the connected creator ecosystem that defines the future of authentic brand storytelling.
 



  




 The Role
 
 We’re looking for a Senior Software Engineer who thrives in the 0→100 phase of a hyper\-growth startup. You’ll grow into a technical co\-leader who doesn’t just execute tasks but owns entire domains, architects scalable solutions, and elevates the team through strong technical leadership.
 



 This is not a typical engineering role. Your work could look something like:
 


* **50%** 
 – Building sophisticated systems, features, and algorithms (creator\-brand matching, recommendation engines, analytics pipelines, real\-time collaboration), improving and extending existing features
* **25%** 
 – Platform evolution (scaling architecture, monitoring, potential containerization and platform migrations)
* **25%** 
 – Technical co\-leadership (architectural decisions, guiding engineers when needed)
* …and then an
 **extra 50%** 
 spent dreaming up the future, inventing, prototyping, spotting the fires no one sees yet, and quietly solving them before anyone panics



  




 What You’ll OwnFeatures \& Product Intelligence
 * Own the lifecycle of sophisticated features: problem framing, prototype, launch, and post\-launch iteration.
* Partner with product to set success metrics for matching, recommendations, and creator\-brand search quality.



  




 Platform \& Infrastructure
 * Design and implement horizontal scaling strategies for services as we grow from thousands to millions of requests
* Optimize SQL Server performance and evaluate data architecture decisions
* Own monitoring, observability, and incident response infrastructure
* Containerize our .NET applications for better resource management and deployment velocity



  




 Technical Leadership
 * Collaborate with product and engineering leaders to guide the team through code reviews, architectural decisions, and quality control
* Make high\-leverage decisions: when to extract microservices, when to refactor vs. rebuild, and when “good enough” is actually right
* Champion engineering best practices while understanding startup trade\-offs \- we ship fast, but we ship with quality
* Bridge between product/design vision and technical execution \- take a rough direction or half\-formed idea from product/eng leadership and turn it into a sharp, well\-scoped spec the team can build against
* Translate the “why” into the “what” and “how”: pressure\-test the vision, surface the edge cases and trade\-offs early, and write specs that are clear enough that the right solution becomes obvious



  




 Our Stack
 * **Backend:** 
 .NET Core, C\#, EF Core, MSSQL Server
* **Frontend:** 
 Next.js, TypeScript, MUI, TanStack Query
* **Infrastructure:** 
 Heroku, Azure, AWS, RabbitMQ
* **Key integrations:** 
 Shopify, Stripe, Autumn, Algolia, Phyllo, Cloudinary, TalkJS, Liveblocks, Knock, SendGrid, Datadog
* **AI:** 
 OpenAI/Anthropic APIs woven into product features where they add real value



  




 You’re a Great Fit IfMust\-Haves
 * 4\-5\+ years of software engineering experience
* Strong algorithm, data structures, and design patterns fluency
* Data and experimentation mindset: define metrics, run A/B tests, and iterate on performance.
* Production Platform/DevOps experience
* Cloud infrastructure knowledge
* Technical leadership \- you’ve influenced architecture and made strategic engineering decisions
* Product sense \& spec\-writing \- you can absorb product/leadership vision, ask the questions that expose what’s really being asked for, and translate it into excellent, buildable specs and features (not just implement tickets handed to you)
* Startup mentality \- you understand that “perfect is the enemy of good” and can make pragmatic trade\-offs
* You’re obsessed with using AI tools like Cursor/Claude Code and beyond, to enhance your effectiveness and productivity, while not sacrificing any quality and maintainability



  




 Nice\-to\-Haves
 * Expertise in .NET, C\#, MSSQL, React/Next.js
* Experience building product features on top of LLM APIs (OpenAI/Anthropic)
* Containerization experience (Docker production; Kubernetes; Terraform)
* Experience with context\-engineering / MCP
* Recsys or marketplace matching experience
* Strong design taste and a track record of great product/UX



  




 You’ll Fail If
 * You need everything to be “perfect” before shipping
* You prefer to work in isolation vs. collaborating closely with product/design/operations/other engineers
* You’re more interested in completing tickets than owning business outcomes
* You need a fully\-specced ticket to start \- you can’t take a vision or rough direction and then iterate and shape it into the right spec and implementation
* You believe in gold\-plating solutions or chasing every new tech trend
* You think responsibility ends at your job title instead of stepping in when something needs to get done



  




 What We Offer
 * Competitive salary range: $140k – $180k, which may vary based on relevant experience, skill level, and geographic location
* Autonomy \& ownership: You’ll influence technical direction and the future of our company
* Modern stack with well\-supported technologies
* Impact: your work directly influences thousands of creators and brands
* Flexible health benefits: a customizable healthcare reimbursement plan to fit your needs.
* Adventure Cash: We’ll cover some of your next adventure—go explore!
* Annual Retreat: A fun, team\-building getaway to recharge and connect with the team.
* Unlimited PTO: Take the time you need to get outside, travel, recharge and perform at your best.



  




 Our Engineering Culture
 * Ship with quality, but ship fast \- we iterate based on real user feedback
* Consistency compounds \- we favor uniform “good enough” patterns
* Fail fast \- clear error handling, early returns, structured logging
* Readable over clever \- clarity beats complexity
* Test what matters \- unit tests for business logic, integration/E2E for critical flows
* See a problem, own the problem \- ownership extends beyond titles



  




 Ready to Build Something Extraordinary?
 
 If this sounds like you and you’re excited about joining our fast\-growing startup, then we want to hear from you!
 



  





**Apply with:** 



1. Your resume, LinkedIn, and GitHub if applicable
2. A brief note explaining one or more of the following:


* Your most impactful technical project in the last 2 years
* Your experience with algorithms/AI and platform/DevOps work
* Why Popfly’s mission and stage excite you



  





*Popfly is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.*

 Curious about how complex business software really works?
   

  

 Our platform processes critical billing and customer operations for organizations that rely on stability, accuracy, and performance. As we modernize our products and architecture, we're seeking someone who can bridge the gap between established systems and modern technologies.
   

  

 This is a role for engineers who enjoy asking "why," digging into complex problems, and continuously learning.
   

  

**This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in the US. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in CST timezone.**
**Salary**
**70K \- 85K**
**AI \& Innovation Mindset**
 We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.
   

  

**What Your Impact Will Be**
* Investigate and solve complex customer and production issues that require both technical expertise and curiosity.
* Work across the full lifecycle of our products, from diagnosing issues to designing and implementing long\-term solutions.
* Contribute to the modernization of established software products into a modern architecture built with Angular and Java.
* Collaborate with Product, Support, QA, and Engineering teams to improve customer outcomes.
* Analyze existing systems to understand business logic, identify opportunities for improvement, and help shape future solutions.
* Participate in architectural discussions and contribute ideas that improve scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
* Build relationships with customers and become a trusted technical resource for solving business\-critical challenges.


**What Makes This Role Interesting**
* Complex real\-world business processes.
* Large, mature codebases with years of accumulated domain knowledge.
* Modernization projects that require thoughtful engineering decisions.
* Direct customer interactions that provide immediate feedback and impact.
* A mix of technologies, including Delphi, Angular, Java, SQL, APIs, and cloud\-ready architectures.
* You'll have the opportunity to learn how enterprise software evolves over time and play a key role in determining what comes next.


**Why Join Us?**
* You'll help shape the future of a platform that customers rely on every day.
* We're looking for engineers who enjoy learning, exploring, and improving systems; not just writing code. If you're energized by solving difficult problems, understanding complex software, and helping modernize products that matter, we'd love to talk with you.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Experience developing software in Delphi or similar strongly typed languages.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* A genuine curiosity about how systems work.
* Interest in both maintaining and improving existing applications while helping build modern solutions.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customers, teammates, and stakeholders.
* Experience working with databases and SQL.
* Desire to learn new technologies and contribute across multiple areas of the product.


**What Would Make You Stand Out**
* Experience with Angular, TypeScript, or modern front\-end development.
* Experience with Java or backend services.
* Knowledge of APIs, integrations, and distributed systems.
* Experience supporting production applications.
* Exposure to billing, financial, utility, or enterprise software systems.

* 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
* Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
* Lifestyle rewards
* Remote work and more!

 Telecommunication companies of all sizes across the United States use MACC’s billing system. Plus, we offer the stability of being a growing company with more than 45 years of experience.

(“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

description_preview:
**This is a job that Jill, our AI Recruiter, is recruiting for on behalf of one of our customers.**
 She will pick the best candidates from Jack's network.
   

  

 The next step is to speak to Jack.
   

  

**Job Title**
 Software Engineer
   

  

**Salary**
 $150k\-$250k \+ Equity
   

  

**Company Description**
 Altara is a San Francisco\-based seed\-stage startup backed by Greylock and Neo building a scientific intelligence platform for the physical world. Founded by former SpaceX and Warp engineers, they are creating the AI layer to accelerate breakthroughs in semiconductors, batteries, and advanced materials by extracting insights from complex, multimodal scientific data.
   

  

**Job Description**
 As an early Software Engineer at Altara, you will architect the core foundations of a platform designed to solve the data challenges of the physical sciences. You’ll build systems that transform messy R\&D data into actionable insights, developing both infrastructure and LLM\-driven agentic workflows to help scientists accelerate discovery in critical global industries.
   

  

**Location**
 San Francisco, USA
   

  

**Why this role is remarkable**
* Join a world\-class founding team from SpaceX, Warp, and Jane Street at the intersection of AI and physical science breakthroughs.
* Backed by elite investors including Greylock, Neo, Jeff Dean, and leadership from OpenAI and AMD, ensuring high\-caliber support and growth.
* Work in a high\-density, in\-person environment in San Francisco where you will directly influence the engineering culture of a category\-defining company.


**What You Will Do**
* Architect and build the early\-stage foundations of Altara’s core product and infrastructure, balancing rapid shipping with long\-term scalability.
* Develop sophisticated data ingestion systems capable of extracting structure from messy, multimodal scientific data like R\&D databases and technical documents.
* Design and implement LLM\-based agentic systems and advanced AI workflows to help scientists solve complex R\&D problems in real\-time.


**The ideal candidate**
* Proven experience shipping 0\-to\-1 products in high\-growth startups, applied AI labs, or top\-tier engineering environments like SpaceX or Microsoft.
* Strong background in building production\-grade AI/ML applications, specifically LLM\-based workflows, search and ranking tools, or computer vision systems.
* Product\-first mindset with a bias toward action, capable of navigating unstructured environments and making smart technical tradeoffs to deliver immediate user value.


**Who are Jack \& Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career.  Curious about how complex business software really works?
   

  

 Our platform processes critical billing and customer operations for organizations that rely on stability, accuracy, and performance. As we modernize our products and architecture, we're seeking someone who can bridge the gap between established systems and modern technologies.
   

  

 This is a role for engineers who enjoy asking "why," digging into complex problems, and continuously learning.
   

  

**This remote role welcomes candidates anywhere in the US. Preference will be given to candidates who can work in CST timezone.**
**Salary**
**70K \- 85K**
**AI \& Innovation Mindset**
 We are committed to leveraging emerging technologies to improve how we work, serve our customers, and drive business outcomes. The successful candidate will demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to actively adopt and leverage AI tools to improve workflows, solve problems, and increase efficiency. Candidates should be comfortable using AI enabled technologies, including copilots, chat based AI assistants, and automation tools, as part of their everyday work while maintaining appropriate judgment, security, and compliance standards.
   

  

**What Your Impact Will Be**
* Investigate and solve complex customer and production issues that require both technical expertise and curiosity.
* Work across the full lifecycle of our products, from diagnosing issues to designing and implementing long\-term solutions.
* Contribute to the modernization of established software products into a modern architecture built with Angular and Java.
* Collaborate with Product, Support, QA, and Engineering teams to improve customer outcomes.
* Analyze existing systems to understand business logic, identify opportunities for improvement, and help shape future solutions.
* Participate in architectural discussions and contribute ideas that improve scalability, maintainability, and user experience.
* Build relationships with customers and become a trusted technical resource for solving business\-critical challenges.


**What Makes This Role Interesting**
* Complex real\-world business processes.
* Large, mature codebases with years of accumulated domain knowledge.
* Modernization projects that require thoughtful engineering decisions.
* Direct customer interactions that provide immediate feedback and impact.
* A mix of technologies, including Delphi, Angular, Java, SQL, APIs, and cloud\-ready architectures.
* You'll have the opportunity to learn how enterprise software evolves over time and play a key role in determining what comes next.


**Why Join Us?**
* You'll help shape the future of a platform that customers rely on every day.
* We're looking for engineers who enjoy learning, exploring, and improving systems; not just writing code. If you're energized by solving difficult problems, understanding complex software, and helping modernize products that matter, we'd love to talk with you.


**What We Are Looking For**
* Experience developing software in Delphi or similar strongly typed languages.
* Strong problem\-solving and debugging skills.
* A genuine curiosity about how systems work.
* Interest in both maintaining and improving existing applications while helping build modern solutions.
* Ability to communicate effectively with customers, teammates, and stakeholders.
* Experience working with databases and SQL.
* Desire to learn new technologies and contribute across multiple areas of the product.


**What Would Make You Stand Out**
* Experience with Angular, TypeScript, or modern front\-end development.
* Experience with Java or backend services.
* Knowledge of APIs, integrations, and distributed systems.
* Experience supporting production applications.
* Exposure to billing, financial, utility, or enterprise software systems.


**What We Can Offer**
* 3 weeks’ vacation and 5 personal days
* Comprehensive Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits starting from your first day of employment
* Employee stock ownership and RRSP/401k matching programs
* Lifestyle rewards
* Remote work and more!


**About MACC**
 Telecommunication companies of all sizes across the United States use MACC’s billing system. Our products empower clients to reach new levels of efficiency through integration and process automation. MACC’s products are supported by professional and dedicated customer care teams to ensure the outstanding service our clients deserve. Plus, we offer the stability of being a growing company with more than 45 years of experience.
   

  

**About Harris**
 Harris is a leading provider of mission critical software to the public sector in North America. As a wholly owned subsidiary of Constellation Software Inc. (“CSI”, symbol CSU on the TSX), Harris has become the cornerstone for CSI’s investment in utility, local government, school districts, public safety, and healthcare software verticals. Our success has been realized through investments in our proprietary software and market expertise. This focus, combined with acquiring businesses that build upon or complement our offerings, has helped drive our success. Harris will continue to growth through reinvestment – both in the people and products that we offer and making investments in acquiring new businesses.

 As a Forward Deployed Engineer at CommodityAI, you will bridge the gap between AI product and physical trade operations. You'll partner with customers to automate unstructured data flows, configure technical schemas, and drive successful deployments. This is a high\-impact role for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of code and customer outcomes.

 San Francisco, USA

* Work at the epicenter of global trade, transforming the foundational sector responsible for moving the world’s energy, metals, and agricultural resources.
* Join a high\-growth environment where the product is selling faster than it can be onboarded, offering massive scale and impact.

**What You Will Do**
* Configure data schemas and AI extraction workflows to turn messy real\-world documents and emails into structured, actionable trade data.

**Who are Jack \& Jill?**
 Ok, I'll go first. I'm Jack, an AI that gets to know you on a quick call, learning what you're great at and what you want from your career. Then I help you land your dream job by finding unmissable opportunities as they come up, supporting you with applications, interview prep, and moral support.
   

  

 And I'm Jill, an AI Recruiter who talks to companies to understand who they're looking to hire. Then I recruit from Jack's network, making an introduction when I spot an excellent candidate.
   

  

**How does this work?**
* Jack's an AI agent for job searching and career coaching. He works for you.
* Jill is the AI recruiter working for the company. She recruits from Jack's network.
* If it's a match and the company wants to meet you, they'll make the intro. In the meantime, if you'd like, Jack will send you excellent alternatives.


**We never post fake jobs**
 This isn't a trick. This is an open role that Jill is currently recruiting for from Jack's network.
   

  

 Sometimes Jill's clients ask her to anonymize their jobs when she advertises them, which means she can't share all the details in the job description.
   

  

 We appreciate this can make them look a bit suspect, but there isn't much we can do about it.

 We’re looking for a Member of Technical Staff (MTS), Research Engineer focused on voice and audio to help advance the spoken intelligence behind Pi. You’ll collaborate closely with ML engineers, product teams, and infrastructure to turn cutting\-edge ideas in areas like neural audio codecs, diffusion\-based TTS, and multimodal foundation models into the natural, expressive voice experiences that millions of Pi users interact with every day.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 



* Research, develop, and optimize neural models for voice and audio—including text\-to\-speech, automatic speech recognition, audio generation, and spoken dialogue systems.
* Build and maintain production\-grade training and inference pipelines for voice models, with close attention to latency, naturalness, and scalability.

**What We’re Looking For** 



* 2–5 years of research or engineering experience (including graduate work) in audio, speech, or multimodal ML.

Manufacturing advanced electronics requires understanding millions of signals generated across complex assembly processes. Instrumental builds systems that capture and analyze those signals — images, test results, and process data — enabling engineers to discover failures, identify root causes, and deploy production controls that improve yield and product maturity. Leading companies such as NVIDIA, Cisco, and Meta rely on Instrumental to accelerate new product development and scale manufacturing across global factories. Instrumental has become mission\-critical for manufacturers building and scaling the next generation of AI infrastructure hardware.
   

  

 Instrumental is seeking a versatile Forward\-Deployed Engineer to join our tight\-knit, high\-performance Customer Experience team. This unique role will blend your hands\-on experience in electronics manufacturing environments with our cutting\-edge AI technology to deliver rapid and impactful results to our customers around the world. You’ll be involved in executing equipment deployments into complex electronics manufacturing lines, training Instrumental algorithms, leveraging our software to accelerate value delivery, and building critical relationships with our customers and their manufacturing partners. You’ll be working with Instrumental’s fastest\-growing customers and delivering against core company missions.
   

  

 This is a great opportunity for someone passionate about improving electronics manufacturing and who loves frequent travel to factories in North America and around the world. The ideal candidate is multi\-faceted, technically savvy, organized, and deeply customer\-oriented.
   

  

**What You’ll Be Doing**
* Own a Mission and Deliver on It. In this role, you’ll travel to customer factory sites, primarily in North America, with a specific, company\-critical mission. Common missions may include setting up and integrating physical equipment and accelerating customer “time to value” by hand\-tuning Instrumental algorithms and software. You’ll have support from our global team, but you’ll be the engineer on the ground who will own mission success.
* Build Relationships with Customer and Factory Stakeholders. While onsite, you’ll endeavor to understand and build rapport with the various stakeholders who are critical to Instrumental’s success and pave the way for further adoption. You’ll leverage these relationships to complete your missions quickly and effectively. You’ll cement a strong technical and dependable reputation for yourself and Instrumental at large.
* Leverage Instrumental’s Software to Drive Value. You’ll quickly become an expert in Instrumental’s software and technology, including many non\-customer\-facing functionalities. This will enable you to quickly identify how to get the most performance out of the system – whether that’s by making a physical tweak in the real\-world, adding training labels, or replicating customer tests. You’ll use your engineer’s understanding of how our customer derive value to rapidly achieve results.


**What You Have**
* Experience getting things done in electronics factories. 3\+ years of professional experience in electronics manufacturing doing engineering or operations – either on the “brand” or EMS side. You understand factory environments, processes, and politics and can leverage that expertise to get things done quickly.
* Love the factory floor more than an office. This role requires frequent travel to customer factory sites, primarily in North America. During peak periods, travel ratio may be as high as 80% of the time – and may include transiting in evenings and on weekends.
* Demonstrated ability to complete your mission. You can share countless stories of mission ownership and completion, where you were able to deliver despite unforeseen or challenging circumstances. You love the idea of applying your diverse engineering and operations skillsets to critical company missions.
* Excellent written and spoken English \+ ideally Mandarin communication. This role will require rapid and effective communication with a variety of global stakeholders, representing Instrumental with our more important customers. We’re looking for someone who enjoys meeting and interacting with people – this is a front\-line role. We will prioritize bilingual English/Mandarin speakers.


 You’re encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn’t precisely match the job description.

 Job leveling and salary opportunity are evaluated through our interview process—we review each applicant's experience, knowledge, skills, and abilities. Instrumental’s benefits include: Health, Vision, Dental, Public Transit/Commuter Plans, and Parental Leave.
   

  

 At Instrumental, protecting company and customer information is a shared responsibility. All employees are expected to comply with company security and privacy policies and promptly report suspected security incidents or policy violations.

* Add analytics \& monitoring to help understand our user experience \& application health
* Contribute in a ton of other ways to a scrappy founding team building the future of flexible light industrial staffing!


**You Have:**
* 3\+ years experience with Typescript, Javascript, React Native, React, Node.js, and/or PostgreSQL
* Experience with Docker
* Experience integrating LLMs or agents into real product—prompting, tool wiring—or a clear drive to learn.
* Experience working in an early\-stage engineering team, working through ambiguity, and being a self\-starter
* A passion for helping people find meaningful work that works for them
